Quick, painless, and protective of your new shades. 😎1. Unbox and inspect — open the case, remove any protective film on the lenses, and check for scratches or manufacturing defects. 2. Try them on — hold the frame level and slide them over your ears; they should sit comfortably without pinching the bridge or temples. 3. Check fit points — make sure: Lens centers sit in front of your eyes, the bridge rests on your nose (not sliding), and the temple tips hug behind your ears without pain. If one temple feels tighter, gently flex the temple outward a tiny bit — don’t force it. 4. Adjust gently if needed — small tweaks only: warm the temple tips with your hands (or a hairdryer on low from a distance) and bend slowly for a better wrap. If you’re unsure, ask us before bending. 5. Test outdoors in daylight — wear them outside to confirm glare reduction and comfort; move your head and notice any slipping. 6. Learn basic cleaning — use the included microfiber cloth and lens cleaner (or mild soap + water). Rinse grit first, then dry with the cloth. Don’t use paper towels, clothing, or household cleaners with ammonia. 7. Store responsibly — keep them in the case when not in use to avoid scratches and pressure damage. 8. Break them in — a few wears usually settles the fit; if something still feels off after a couple days, we can help with sizing advice or an exchange. 9.
